mostWorthwhile.text: Adding fibrin to the platelet plug was most worthwhile: the planned picture and explanation show how the plug is reinforced without implying the skin has healed.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making fibrin threads was less informative: the result shows a mesh but does not explain how the activated clotting factors act on fibrinogen.

surprise.text: The vessel was shown narrowing immediately after the cut, but its role in limiting blood loss was not explained.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though the activated clotting factors were supplied without explaining how they became activated.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the still-open skin closes; the distinction between stopping bleeding and repairing tissue gives the next passage a clear hook.
